_meta.purpose: Root-cause classification of every NEEDS_REVIEW check remaining after the 2026-08-01 remediation passes (15 wired NOT_APPLICABLE via precondition-negation, Category C decided as assume-DU) -- the same 'name the ORIGINAL issue, not an opaque engine bucket' discipline already applied to NOT_COMPILED via doc_decidability_classification.json. All rows are scripted_review checks whose REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW fallback fired; the category says WHY a human is needed. Coverage-asserted at build time against BOTH engines' live result sets (identical 109-row NEEDS_REVIEW sets, verified 2026-08-01).
_meta.provenance: Built from the 5-batch parallel investigation of all 121 then-NEEDS_REVIEW checks (2026-08-01, see output/BAKEOFF-P0-VS-SRC-GOLD-RULESET-2026-07-31.md Addenda 11-12) plus the 11-row second-look verification pass. Per-check evidence (exact payload field paths and values) lives in the addenda; notes here are distilled one-liners.

categories.IRREDUCIBLE_JUDGMENT: genuine human judgment (photos, narrative review, fair-lending determinations, legal validity) -- no field-level proxy possible even in principle; the honest permanent floor
categories.EXTRACTION_GAP_DOC_PRESENT: the source document IS in the file but the deciding fields are unextracted/null -- becomes decidable if Touchless extraction widens (vendor question C)
categories.DATA_NEVER_CAPTURED: no field or document for this concept exists anywhere in the current data contract -- needs a new vendor data element, not better extraction
categories.EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_STATE: requires content from inside DU/CU/UCD or similar external systems this project cannot reach
categories.CONFIRMED_RED_FLAG: the loan's own data AFFIRMATIVELY exhibits the condition the check screens for -- these are the review queue working as intended; never auto-clear
categories.VENDOR_DATA_TRUST: an on-point field exists and is populated but its value is implausible or snapshot-stale -- pending vendor confirmation, unusable either direction
categories.NEEDS_RULE_LOGIC: data partially present but resolution needs real added logic (eligibility matrix, geocoding) -- a build candidate, not a wire

clusters.electronic_closing: 13 DATA_NEVER_CAPTURED rows all hang on ONE unknowable boolean -- was this an electronic/RON/RIN closing? Payload has a plain 'Note' doc and zero e-closing signals; under the disjunction rule an unknown trigger never excludes, so all 13 stay. Single highest-leverage vendor question in this bucket: one yes/no field could resolve 13 checks at once (a 'no' makes them all NOT_APPLICABLE).
